text: AgenticMemory identifies session-boundary memory loss as a mechanism by which accumulated agent knowledge fails to persist. This independently corresponds to Kaal's claim that episodic interactions and ephemeral evaluation prevent an agent's track record from reshaping later behavior. The source addresses memory persistence, not the separate incentive design needed to turn persistent history into reputational consequence.
